review.imagery: Root reviewed all9 native brochure resources and four observed website originals. Nine original Safa1 brochure scenes are selected, with the own building corner on its card. Current broader-Safa hero and repeated website crops are excluded. Shared Safa pool/bedroom and Aljada context remain qualified.
review.floorPlans: Root reviewed all12 staged complete original spreads, all12 final residence footer panels and the regional/community/project-marked maps. Six paired spreads preserve all12 types. All seven building floors span three complete source spreads. The selected11 choices include the project and community master plans. Printed totals match the visible final panels.
review.location: Root visually confirmed all four Aljada journey estimates on physical page6 and the exact red building footprint on page16. The shared community Google embed does not establish this building’s entrance, so coordinates remain unset and directions use the protected project name. No exact distance or live route is inferred.
review.provenance: Current official HTML, original brochure and observed images were cached by ordinary public GET with dated byte-count and SHA256 receipts. Complete source notices and physical-page links remain available. Canonical researched text and protected identities are preserved.

unavailable: Exact visitor-entrance coordinates, kilometre routes and apartment-specific travel times remain unverified. Images are proposed designs and shared community/interior concepts. Inventory, final finishes and contracted drawing revisions require confirmation.
